classifier.allowed_external_difference: input-loader plumbing only; measurement/operator body is runtime-materialized from the frozen source

denominators.eligible_route_n: state-certified routes with one ordinary FB and a contiguous ROUX_SB span; this equals classifier ordinary_fb_sb_eligible
denominators.preexisting_canonical_rate_given_prefix_: canonical / prefix_unique, exactly as frozen in G4_EXTERNAL_COURT_FREEZE
denominators.cmll_consistency_rate: cmll_consistent / cmll_opportunities; zero opportunities is NOT evaluable and therefore cannot pass fresh authority
denominators.lse_consistency_rate: lse_consistent / lse_opportunities; zero opportunities is NOT evaluable and therefore cannot pass fresh authority
denominators.null_fallback_rate: external canonical features lacking every frozen local-reference level / all external canonical features
denominators.familywise_watch_rate: canonical external attempts with frozen-reference familywise p<=0.05 / canonical external attempts with a finite attempt statistic
denominators.familywise_primary_rate: canonical external attempts with frozen-reference familywise p<=0.01 / canonical external attempts with a finite attempt statistic

reference_scoring.familywise_p: add-one upper-tail against all finite frozen G4 LOO attempt statistics
